claim: A 2,500 gram parcel to zone B costs 12.00, because it is billed as 3 kg at 4.00 per kg.
why: billed_kg uses Python round, which rounds halves to the nearest even number, so 2.5 becomes 2, not 3. The parcel is billed as 2 kg and costs 8.00. The README promises halves up and the 3500 gram case rounds up to 4, which hides the difference unless the 2500 gram case is run.

deciding.note: 2500 g is billed as 2 kg, not 3 kg

root.claim: A 2,500 gram parcel to zone B costs 12.00, because it is billed as 3 kg at 4.00 per kg.

atoms.claim: The 2,500 gram parcel is billed as 3 kg
atoms.evidence: Ran main.py: the 2500 B line prints 8.00, so billed_kg(2500) is 2 because round(2.5) is 2.

atoms.claim: The zone B rate is 4.00 per kg
